mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consultants (first_name, last_name, salary, industry, managers_id) VALUES (#{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{salary}, #{industry}, #{manager.id})
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, m.id AS manager_id, m.first_name AS manager_name FROM consultants c LEFT JOIN managers m ON c.managers_id = m.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT c.*, m.id AS manager_id, m.first_name AS manager_name FROM consultants c LEFT JOIN managers m ON c.managers_id = m.id
SELECT c.*, m.id AS manager_id, m.first_name AS manager_name FROM consultants c LEFT JOIN managers m ON c.managers_id = m.id WHERE c.industry = #{industry}
SELECT c.*, m.id AS manager_id, m.first_name AS manager_name FROM consultants c LEFT JOIN managers m ON c.managers_id = m.id WHERE c.salary BETWEEN #{minSalary} AND #{maxSalary}
SELECT c.*, m.id AS manager_id, m.first_name AS manager_name FROM consultants c LEFT JOIN managers m ON c.managers_id = m.id WHERE c.managers_id = #{managerId}

SELECT c.*, m.id AS manager_id, m.first_name AS manager_name FROM consultants c JOIN consultant_projects cp ON c.id = cp.consultants_id JOIN managers m ON c.managers_id = m.id WHERE cp.projects_id = #{projectId} AND m.id = #{managerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE consultants SET salary = #{newSalary} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE consultants SET industry = #{newIndustry} WHERE id = #{id}
